theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Myth: Mutual Funds Are Only for the Wealthy
body: False. Mutual funds welcome investors with modest amounts. Systematic investing plans make them accessible to everyone.
caption: Many believe mutual funds require large initial investments. In reality, structured investment approaches democratize market participation for all income levels. Start small, invest consistently, grow steadily. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingForAll #FinancialInclusion #SmartInvesting #DemystifyingMF
